phases.name: One-day build: infra branch + dashboard branch, one PR
phases.gate: terraform validate clean; PR from feat/dashboard into feat/azure-cd deploys successfully; unauthenticated dashboard/ingest access rejected; a real Pi wake cycle produces a visible dashboard row within 30s; a retried event_id upserts instead of duplicating (ADR-0014); events pushed while offline appear once connectivity returns, via sync_queue.jsonl (ADR-0015); ruff+mypy clean across cloud/ and agent/

tasks.summary: Branch feat/azure-cd. Terraform (cloud/infra/): Storage Account (Blob 'snapshots' + Table 'events', F02), Container App Environment + Container App (scale-to-zero, F01/F04/F05 runtime), ghcr.io pull credential, secret/env blocks for DASHBOARD_PASSWORD + Storage connection string. GitHub Actions workflow (.github/workflows/deploy.yml) triggered on PR (opened/synchronize) into feat/azure-cd: build cloud/app/Dockerfile, push to ghcr.io, terraform apply. Prove the pipeline once against a placeholder image before feat/dashboard exists.

Branch feat/dashboard (off feat/rpi). cloud/app/: FastAPI app with POST/GET /api/events, GET /api/events/{id} (F01), require_basic_auth() dependency applied globally (F05, shared ids/ids-default credential), server-rendered dashboard pages -- event list, real/false/email-rate metrics band, per-event detail with image + Gemini reasoning + email status (F04). Pydantic schema validation + 2MB image cap on ingest. Unit tests for auth rejection and payload validation.

On feat/dashboard. agent/machine.py: generate event_id (ULID) at decision time, capture email_sent from notifier.notify() outcome, add both to _log_event()'s local record. agent/cloud_sync.py: build_payload()/push()/flush_queue() with (3,5)s bounded timeout, shared Basic Auth credential from config.Settings, never raises. agent/sync_queue.py (ADR-0015): bounded local JSONL queue (sync_queue.jsonl, cap 20 events, 5 flushed/cycle, 5 attempts/event before drop) -- enqueue on push failure, flush_queue() retries oldest-first after every cycle's own push, stopping at first failure. config.py: CLOUD_SYNC_*/SYNC_QUEUE_* constants + Settings.cloud_sync_user/cloud_sync_password (optional, not required). Unit tests for cloud_sync.py (mocked HTTP, mirrors tests/test_notifier.py) and sync_queue.py (cap eviction, attempts tracking, corrupted-line tolerance). Depends on T04 being deployed first (server must accept client-supplied event_id before this can push successfully). Open the feat/dashboard -> feat/azure-cd PR (triggers T01's pipeline); once deployed, manually trigger a real wake cycle and confirm the event appears within 30s, then run the offline-then-reconnect check (01-system-overview.md Evaluation Framework).

On feat/dashboard, retrofitting T02's already-shipped cloud/app/ (ADR-0014, driven by T03's new local retry queue). schemas.py: EventIn gains a required event_id field, validated as a well-formed ULID (26-char Crockford base32), 422 on anything else. routes_api.py: ingest_event() no longer calls storage.generate_ulid() -- uses payload.event_id instead. storage.py: write_event() becomes an upsert (create_or_replace) keyed on the client-supplied event_id instead of a strict create, so a retried event_id overwrites identical data rather than erroring/duplicating; write_blob() is already overwrite=True and needs no change. Unit tests: upsert idempotency (same event_id posted twice yields one row, second response still 202 with the same event_id), malformed event_id rejected with 422. Must merge/deploy before T03's Pi-side retries have anything correct to push against.
